THE SMART WAY

Your information. Your choice.

How the website’s estimate helper works and what happens when you contact Smart Way.

Your estimate details

The estimate helper prepares a text using the information you enter, including your name, city, vehicle, service preference, and damage description. It does not submit an estimate request to a website database. You choose whether to open your messaging app or copy the message, add photos, and send it to Smart Way.

Messages and photos

When you send a text or make a call, your phone number, message, and any photos you attach are shared with the business and handled through your phone provider and messaging service. Message and data rates may apply. Contact Smart Way at (954) 905-2386 for questions about your request or communication preferences.

Website storage and outside services

This website does not use advertising trackers or save estimate details in browser storage. Hosting providers may process standard technical request information. Google Fonts supplies the website fonts. Links to Google Maps and Google reviews open Google services, which have their own privacy practices.

Estimates and availability

Sending an estimate inquiry does not confirm an appointment, final price, or repair time. The team must review the damage and confirm service availability. Mobile service and same-day options depend on the repair and location.

Get in touch

For repair or privacy questions, call or text (954) 905-2386, or visit our contact page.
